The passages do not identify a proposal specifically aimed at preventing damage to **task-irrelevant parts** of an environment.

They do describe a related general safety method, **Recovery RL**: it filters proposed task-policy actions using an estimated risk of constraint violations. If an action is judged unsafe, a learned recovery policy supplies an alternative action intended to return the agent to sufficiently safe regions (https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.15920).
